evals.name: radisson-development-underwrite
evals.prompt: Run a full underwriting on Radisson Mining (RDS.V) after Agnico Eagle's strategic investment. We already established that Agnico invested above market, received governance and ownership rights, and O'Brien has an expanding resource. Do not restart the research from scratch. Determine whether RDS is investable at today's CAD price after future mine financing, dilution, resource conversion, milling risk and realistic bear/base/bull project values. Compare it with the closest realistic alternative, state the required-return rule you used, and prepare a portfolio handoff. Also tell me whether this is a 3-month, 1-year or multi-year investment and give an actual re-underwrite date.
evals.expected_output: Uses mining overlay and existing handoff; anchors current CAD price and fully diluted/post-financing capitalization; distinguishes strategic validation from takeover speculation; performs project NAV and a cross-check; estimates what is priced in; models financing/dilution and genuine scenarios; calculates expected and annualized return; applies the user's hurdle if available or labels it unavailable and shows sensitivity; compares a realistic alternative; gives target realization and mandatory re-underwrite dates; identifies kill criteria; states challenger status; provides portfolio/risk inputs; ends with one allowed posture.

evals.name: amazon-compounder-underwrite
evals.prompt: Take our existing Amazon research to full underwriting. Is AMZN investable at the current price based on AWS AI demand, retail margin expansion, capex intensity and free-cash-flow normalization? State what today's price implies, give bear/base/bull values, compare the expected return with a broad index or the closest active alternative, and explain whether this is a 6-month trade, a 2-year investment or a 5-year compounder. Give a calendar re-underwrite date and an independent-challenge status.
evals.expected_output: Preserves existing research; anchors current price and capitalization; identifies measurable variant perception and reverse valuation; connects demand/utilization/capex to operating profit and cash returns; separates fundamentals from multiple expansion; compares expected annualized return, downside, confidence and duration with the chosen alternative; does not invent a personal hurdle; sets target and re-underwrite dates; reconciles or clearly labels the independent challenger; provides portfolio handoff; ends with one allowed posture.

evals.name: biotech-hold-underwrite
evals.prompt: Underwrite a clinical-stage biotech after a major FDA clinical hold caused a 25% decline. The lead program is important but not the only asset. Patients are currently clinically stable, causality is unresolved and there is some class safety precedent. Determine whether the selloff is an investable asymmetric opportunity. I want market-implied program probability, rNPV scenarios, runway and dilution, strongest safety countercase, return-hurdle sensitivity, closest alternative, a specific thesis end date, and a challenger pass before capital allocation.
evals.expected_output: Uses biotech/event overlay; separates clinical evidence, regulatory probability and commercial value; anchors EV and runway; includes future financing/dilution; uses rNPV or market-implied probability; provides delay/success/failure scenarios with timing; calculates required probability to meet hurdle sensitivity; compares a realistic alternative; sets realization/re-underwrite dates tied to the FDA process; runs or labels challenger status; may conclude Watch/Pass; provides portfolio handoff.
